summary: @servicetitan/hash-browser-router preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNNNN identifiers and property-indirection wrappers around execFileSync/https.get. On install it downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 for the current platform, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line file prefixed with "// @bun @bun-cjs" containing a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW) and a ~2000-entry mixed number/string lookup table used to reconstruct symbols at runtime — a Bun-compiled opaque payload. The package's declared purpose is a React hash-based router; a hash-router library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at install time and use it to execute an obfuscated blob. Executing math_init.js via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime evades Node-oriented scanners and hands arbitrary code execution to the payload on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
